statement: The function returns a result r (a 64-bit integer) and the following hold. If there exist indices i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums) and nums[i] < nums[j], then (a) there exist such indices i,j with r = nums[j] - nums[i], and (b) for every such pair i,j, nums[j] - nums[i] <= r. If no such pair i,j exists, then r = -1.
preconditions: len(nums) = n, 2 <= n <= 1000, and for every k with 0 <= k < len(nums), 1 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000.
